iface.description: Network interface name to capture from (e.g., eth0). Leave empty if reading from PCAP files only.

outdir.description: Directory where flow transcript files are written.

inputs.description: List of PCAP filenames to read. If empty and iface is set, tcpflow captures live traffic.

bpf_filter.description: BPF filter expression to select packets (e.g., 'tcp port 80'). Leave empty for all packets.

max_bytes.description: Maximum size of a captured flow in bytes. Leave empty for unlimited.

debug_level.description: Debug level (0-10). Higher numbers produce more messages to stderr.

max_fds.description: Max file descriptors to use. 0 uses OS default.

scanners.description: List of scanner names to enable (e.g., 'http', 'md5', 'python'). Empty to disable specific scanners.

plugin_params.description: List of key=value strings for plugin parameters (-S flag).

filename_format.description: Custom filename template using %-specifiers (e.g., '%A/%B/%c') or format flags (e.g., 'k'). If empty, default naming is used.

binning.description: Binning flag: 'k' (1K dirs), 'm' (1M dirs), 'g' (1G dirs), or 'none'. Ignored if filename_format is set.

dfxml_report.description: Filename for the DFXML report. Empty for default 'report.xml'.

relinquish_privileges.description: Username to change to after opening capture device/file. Empty to keep running as original user.

hex_console.description: Print console output in hex format.

store_timestamps.description: Store reception timestamps in companion .findx files.
